title: 筹码商店可打开：菜单 slots=3+36、单价=priceOf(0)=10、刷新 3/5、三格候选均为 astral_dice 筹码且品质码 1..3、deny=-1（证据 shop/ChipShopOpener.java:44-67；shop/ChipShopState.java:68-121；shop/ChipShopCatalog.java:47,81-83,93-94,305-307；shop/ChipShopMenu.java:68-73,146-208,295-333）

steps.text: 判据来源：ChipShopOpener.java:44-67 open 前先跑 owned_all / inventory_full / cooldown 三道拒绝（本用例先 store(EMPTY) 把冷却与刷新归零，保证不撞 deny），:60 ensureOffers 后 openMenu；ChipShopMenu.java:68-73 OFFER_SLOTS=3 + PLAYER_SLOT_COUNT=36 ⇒ slots.size()=39；:100 DATA_SLOT_COUNT=7；:295-333 price/remainingRefreshes/totalRefreshes/denyReason/offerStack/offerTier/offersKey；价格公式 ChipShopCatalog.java:305-307 priceOf(0)=PRICE_INITIAL=10；刷新常量 :93-94 REFRESH_INITIAL=3 / REFRESH_MAX=5；:103-115 DENY_NONE=-1。末尾 closeContainer + store(EMPTY) 复原。
